reason: I only pass that exit two mornings a week, and it's a brand-new spot inside what honestly looks like a closed bar with zero Google reviews. I'm not going to gamble $7.50 on a cherry pie matcha from a place I can't look up first when I have my usual coffee on the way.
objection: No reviews and no track record, and the setup inside a bar at 6am makes me wonder whether it's a real café or a side hustle that'll be gone in two months.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a solid Google rating (4.5+ with a few dozen reviews) or a friend posting the halva latte. Then I'd use the free matcha sip as an excuse to try it.
